## Atlas Packages {.section-header}

Brain atlas datasets compatible with ggseg and ggseg3d. Each package provides polygon and/or mesh data for specific brain parcellations.

### Installation

Install any atlas package from R-universe:

```r
install.packages(
 "ggsegYeo2011",
 repos = c(
   "https://ggseg.r-universe.dev",
   "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```
